# `adt srvd`

ABAP service definition operations

```bash
adt srvd [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command             | Description                                     |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `adt srvd create`   | Create a new ABAP service definition            |
| `adt srvd read`     | Read source code of an ABAP service definition  |
| `adt srvd write`    | Write source code to an ABAP service definition |
| `adt srvd activate` | Activate one or more ABAP service definition(s) |
| `adt srvd delete`   | Delete an ABAP service definition               |

## `adt srvd create`

Create a new ABAP service definition

```bash
adt srvd create [options] <name> <description> <package>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description             | Default |
| --------------- | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | service definition name |         |
| `<description>` | Short description       |         |
| `<package>`     | Package name            |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                               | Default |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number                  |         |
| `--no-error-existing`      | Skip if service definition already exists | `false` |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                            |         |

## `adt srvd read`

Read source code of an ABAP service definition

```bash
adt srvd read [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description             | Default |
| -------- | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | service definition name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                                                                     | Default |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`              | Output metadata as JSON (no source)                                                             |         |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write source to &lt;file&gt; in UTF-8 instead of stdout (avoids shell redirect encoding issues) |         |

## `adt srvd write`

Write source code to an ABAP service definition

```bash
adt srvd write [options] <name> [file]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                        | Default |
| -------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | service definition name            |         |
| `[file]` | Source file path (use - for stdin) | `-`     |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `--activate`               | Activate after writing   |         |

## `adt srvd activate`

Activate one or more ABAP service definition(s)

```bash
adt srvd activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description                | Default |
| ------------ | -------------------------- | ------- |
| `<names...>` | service definition name(s) |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description    | Default |
| -------- | -------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output as JSON |         |

## `adt srvd delete`

Delete an ABAP service definition

```bash
adt srvd delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description             | Default |
| -------- | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | service definition name |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON           |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
